verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches agent credentials. The Web API spec distinguishes user and bot user tokens, so an app or agent can hold its own bot credential. Workspace admins can approve and manage MCP client integrations, which is a governance control rather than credential scoping. Nothing in the pack documents granular OAuth scopes or least-privilege permission selection. Missing for 10: documented per-token scopes or permissions, least-privilege scope selection when issuing agent credentials, token rotation or revocation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
